steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with two bids directly on Master QCS.
Ensure the required eRFX project configuration is enabled for the tenant.
Verify that both bidding vendors appear as real vendor columns.
Verify that the lower bid ranks better than the higher bid.
Verify the per-line amounts and vendor totals are calculated correctly from rate and quantity.
